scenicChapters.title: Upper Mustang Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 19 km this is Upper Mustang Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

upper-mustang-road.story: A one-way ride of 260 km, Pokhara to the finish - roughly 3 h 31 in the saddle. The stops in between: Jomsom, Kagbeni and Ghami. The highest point is about 5,200 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
